observations: Photo 0 shows a black HP monitor with a visible HP logo on the bottom bezel and a green power indicator light. The screen is off, reflecting the ceiling and the person taking the photo. The model number 'HP 2309h' is visible on the bottom right of the bezel.

Photo 1 shows the back of the monitor with the HP logo centered. There is a label with specifications and regulatory marks, but the text is too small to read clearly. The stand is attached and appears to be standard.

Photo 2 shows the side ports: HDMI (green), DVI (white), and VGA (blue). The HDMI port is labeled with an icon and text 'HDMI'. There is no visible USB port on this side. The casing has a perforated design around the ports.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the model 'HP 2309h' on the bezel, which is a 23-inch monitor.
Photo 2 shows HDMI and VGA ports, but no USB port is visible. The seller's claim of a USB port is not supported by the photos.
The monitor appears to have some smudges and reflections on the screen (photo 0) and minor dust on the back (photo 1). 'Very clean' is subjective and not verifiable from the photos alone.

risks.risk: Screen damage or dead pixels not visible in reflection
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the screen with a solid white or black background to reveal any blemishes or dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential screen defects

risks.risk: Monitor not functional or missing power cable
risks.proof: A video clip showing the monitor turning on and displaying an image, or a photo of the power cable and adapter.

risks.risk: Missing USB port as claimed by seller
risks.proof: A photo of the other side or back of the monitor showing all ports, or a clear denial from the seller that there is no USB port.

proof_requests: A photo or video showing the monitor turned on and displaying an image.
A photo of the other side or back of the monitor to confirm or deny the presence of a USB port.
A close-up photo of the screen with a solid white or black background to check for dead pixels or damage.
response.reason: The monitor is identifiable as an HP 2309h, and the photos confirm HDMI and VGA ports. The claim of a USB port is contradicted by the photos. The condition is unverified but not clearly damaged. The item can be priced at its worst case (as not working or lacking USB port) until further proof is provided.
